notes: Rare-level collapsing: PROC FREQ OUT= to flag rare categorical levels, by-group MERGE to recode to OTHER, CALL SYMPUTX/SYMGETN feedback loop to merge a too-small OTHER home_ownership bucket into RENT. The *_c columns are materialised with upcase(strip(...)) of the real category fields (as the upstream 03 step does). Input is a 60-row real slice of scored_sample.csv, inlined via DATALINES; collapsing logic unchanged.
